# iDig Webapp — Wiki

iDig Webapp is a Vue 3 / Vite web application that lets teams connect to an iDig server, browse trench data, and work with maps, tables, and exports.

A public demo is available at **https://idig.archaiodata.com/**.

## Quick start

1. Open the app and create a connection profile (server, project, username, password).
2. Click **Connect** — preferences are fetched from the server and stored locally.
3. Select one or more sectors (trenches) in the left sidebar.
4. Choose the item type and the fields you want to display.
5. Browse the table, open items, search, and export data.
